title: Thruhiking Bucket List
description: Long-distance trails I have completed and the routes I want to hike next, in North America and beyond.

trips.description: About 1,287 km (800 mi) across Arizona from the Utah border to the Mexico border.
trips.note: Hiked from Page to the Mexico border.

trips.description: 782-790 km (486-491 mi) from Denver to Durango, Colorado, depending on the Collegiate route.
trips.note: Hiked from Denver to Durango via the Collegiate West alternate.

trips.description: About 4,989 km (3,100 mi) from Mexico to Canada along the Rocky Mountains in the USA.
trips.note: Hiked sections in the Wind River Range, Yellowstone, Colorado via the Colorado Trail and San Juan Mountains, and Gila Canyon. Goal: attempt the full trail.

trips.description: About 1,123 km (698 mi) through the Canadian Rockies in Alberta and British Columbia.
trips.note: Hiked sections through Banff and Jasper. Goal: hike the full trail in one trip.

trips.description: About 340 km (211 mi) from Yosemite Valley to the summit of Mount Whitney in California.
trips.note: Hiked from Yosemite via Little Yosemite Valley to the summit of Mount Whitney.

trips.description: About 4,265 km (2,650 mi) from Mexico to Canada through California, Oregon, and Washington.
trips.note: Hiked the Washington section on my first attempt in 2026. Goal: hike the full trail.

trips.description: About 314 km (195 mi) from Road’s End in Kings Canyon to Twin Lakes through California’s High Sierra, largely off trail.
About 129 km (80 mi) from Leidy Peak to Hayden Pass across Utah’s Uinta Mountains.
trips.note: Hiked from Leidy Peak to Hayden Pass Trailhead, skipping the first dry section. Arranging the shuttle with two cars was a bit challenging.

trips.description: A 150 km (93 mi) loop around Mount Rainier in Washington.
About 180 km (112 mi) from Bressanone to Feltre through Italy’s Dolomites.
About 370 km (230 mi) from Fort William to Cape Wrath in Scotland, UK; distance varies with the route.
About 840 km (522 mi) across the Pyrenees through Spain and Andorra; distance varies with the route.
About 180 km (112 mi) from Calenzana to Conca across Corsica, France.

trips.text: Great Himalaya Trail — Nepal High Route
trips.description: About 1,700 km (1,056 mi) on the high route across Nepal.
3,034 km (1,885 mi) across France from the Vosges to the Pyrenees.
About 450 km (280 mi) from Abisko to Hemavan in Sweden.
About 80 km (50 mi) from Landmannalaugar to Skógar via Þórsmörk in Iceland.
trips.note: Hiked hut to hut from Landmannalaugar to Skógar. Rugged but beautifully remote.

trips.description: About 800 km (497 mi) through Norway, Sweden, and Finland.
About 750 km (466 mi) along the high Pyrenees through France, Spain, and Andorra, on a largely unmarked route.
About 1,363 km (847 mi) across New Zealand’s South Island.
About 2,000 km (1,243 mi) across eight Alpine countries from the Adriatic to Monaco on the current main route.
About 1,260 km (783 mi) on the White Trail from Slovenia through Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Montenegro to Albania.
